game_concept: A tower defense set in Frost Peaks – Frozen Waterfall, a frozen waterfall: the rescue climber must handle frost wyrms while practicing strings & dictionaries. Core idea – Key Vault: Look up values in a dictionary by key to open the radio mast.
theme: Frost Peaks – Frozen Waterfall: a frozen waterfall
core_gameplay_loop: In Frozen Waterfall, repeat each round: Look up values in a dictionary by key to open the radio mast. Each round, frost wyrms strike the radio mast, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the vault_keys value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Protect the radio mast from frost wyrms in Frozen Waterfall: keep the vault_keys meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 31-second timer ends.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
lose_condition: vault_keys drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 31-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 8 – Strings & Dictionaries | Level 4 (applied tier): Key Vault
assets_style: towering pixel-art mountains: glaciers, jagged ice ridges, crisp white and cyan with deep blue shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; thin howling wind, high strings and ice-crack stings
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Key Vault' (Week 8 slot 7), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Frozen Waterfall'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Frost Peaks
region.mood: thin howling wind, high strings and ice-crack stings

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how vault_keys changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against frost wyrms in Frozen Waterfall.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 31 seconds while vault_keys > 0.
